name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

dropCalls.title: Drop whole tool calls
dropCalls.description: When Jev rates a call as no longer needed, remove the call and its result. Off: keep the call as a stub, its tool name with input and result cut to a head, so the history still shows a tool call before every report; a call an earlier compaction already stubbed is removed.

note.title: Note after compaction
note.description: End the compacted history with a short note: what was cut, what the host had stored beside messages and how it was put back (whole or shortened, with transcript lines), and where the full transcript is.

putBackBudget.title: Put-back budget (characters)
putBackBudget.description: Characters of reports from other sessions carried whole per compaction, newest first; the rest are put back as a head. Prompts the user typed are always whole and not counted.

reportHeadChars.title: Report head (characters)
reportHeadChars.description: How much of a report past the budget is put back; the whole text stays at its transcript line.

taskHeadChars.title: Task notification head (characters)
taskHeadChars.description: A background task's notification is put back as its summary, status and output file, at most this long.

hostLineChars.title: Host message line (characters)
hostLineChars.description: Hook feedback, goal check-ins and other host notices are put back as their first line, at most this long.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
